notes: Access: direct fetch worked throughout, no WAF/blocking encountered, no proxy needed. LANGUAGE CHECK (per brief instruction): the assigned /en-eu/ locale path renders genuinely English UI and product copy (nav labels 'Lighting'/'Furniture'/'Decor'/'Curtains'/'Rugs'/'Home Textiles', product titles like 'Donna Burgundy Vase', 'Marcello black lacquered mirror') even though the underlying Shopify collection-handle slugs are French (e.g. /collections/luminaires, /collections/miroir, /collections/vase) -- no French-to-English translation of category/sub_category was needed since the site itself already serves English strings at this locale; French slugs are quoted in evidence only. PLATFORM: headless Shopify storefront on a custom Next.js/Vercel frontend (not a Liquid theme -- /collections.json and /collections/<h>/products.json both 404 to the Next.js app-router 404 page, so standard Shopify JSON probes do not apply here). Category listing pages are powered by Algolia InstantSearch; the server-rendered HTML embeds the initial Algolia response as an RSC payload containing nbHits, hitsPerPage, nbPages, exhaustiveNbHits and a filters param of the form filters=collectionsHandles:"<handle>" scoped to that exact collection. QTY VERIFICATION (Rule 1): for every leaf row extracted, evidence is the embedded nbHits value, cross-checked against (a) exhaustiveNbHits:true explicitly present in the same payload for every included collection (vase, miroir, petits-objets, applique, lampadaire, lampe-a-poser, suspension, luminaires), and (b) ceil(nbHits/hitsPerPage)==nbPages holding exactly (hitsPerPage=24 site-wide; verified for miroir 5->1pg, lampadaire 8->1pg, suspension 12->1pg, vase 34->2pg). Lighting parent (luminaires) nbHits=75 vs its 4 children summing to 77 -- a small, acceptable overlap per Rule 1's 'children sum to roughly the parent' check, not a duplicate-listing situation (each child page's own filters param is scoped to its own distinct handle). EXCLUDED as mixed roll-ups / out of scope after inspecting actual product titles+productType inside each collection's own Algolia payload (not the sitewide 'Iconic Pieces' recommendation widget that is embedded identically on every page and was discarded as noise): decoration-1 ('Decor', nbHits=187) is a rollup mixing cushions/quilts/rugs/scented candles with the genuine decor items already counted separately (vase, petits-objets, miroir) -- dropped per 'mixed roll-ups: drop them, don't pad'. bougie-et-bougeoir ('Candles & Candle Holders', nbHits=17) is roughly half La Candela SCENTED candles/refills (Home Fragrance, excluded) and half Anna candle holders (would qualify), with no separate unscented-only listing/URL to isolate the holders -- dropped per the Home Fragrance rule ('take unscented children where they exist as their own listing; drop the whole node where they don't'). art-de-la-table ('Tableware', nbHits=41) is dominated by Lisa Corti placemats/tablecloths/napkins (table linens = standing textile exclusion) plus reused vase/candleholder SKUs already counted under vase/petits-objets -- dropped as a facet/overlap re-cut, no clean standalone tableware/serveware subset found. outdoor (nbHits=14): first item and productType is 'Mobilier' (outdoor modular sofa), material facets are Jacquard/Textured fabric -- genuinely outdoor furniture/textiles, not outdoor lighting or decorative mirrors (which, if present at all, are already inside applique/lampadaire/lampe-a-poser/suspension/miroir) -- dropped as furniture per Rule 0.5. Also dropped: all furniture collections (mobilier, fauteuil-et-chaise, canape, banc, chaise-de-bar, meuble-et-bureau, pouf, table-basse, table-de-chevet, table-de-salle-a-manger, tete-de-lit, mobilier-en-livraison-rapide), all textile collections (coussin, linge-de-lit, linge-de-maison, plaid, rideaux, tapis), and cross-cutting marketing/print collections that are not real product-type categories (dernieres-pieces/'Archives'-clearance, ldg-les-iconiques/'Iconic Pieces'-bestsellers, edition-leopard, la-rayure, lart-du-rose -- themed print/pattern capsule collections spanning furniture+textiles+decor, confirmed by sampling; excluded per the Featured/Best Sellers/Collection navigation rule). 'image', 'bougeoir', 'deco', 'pushs', 'gioia' all 404 or are single-product artifacts, not real collections. petits-objets (Small Decorative Objects, nbHits=19) includes one incidental non-decor 'Retrospective Book' SKU inside an otherwise clean decorative catchalls/pots/trays collection; kept as-is since it is the site's own exact reported total for that URL and the category is fundamentally decor, not a mixed rollup. No wallpaper, no artificial plants, no holiday/gift nodes found in the nav.
